mike: CI red on gpu-nightly/9213 — unified memory spike + OOM on h100 nodes. cc @anu @ryan. logs: https://ci.redwood/9213/artifacts :alarm_clock:
anu: on it, can you paste the top of the worker dmesg? also which driver did this run use?
sophia: :eyes: tagging infra too in case it's a kernel/driver skew.
mike: driver 535.101.05 (from image). dmesg snippet:
```
[1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:5e:00): 79, pid=1423, gpu=0, reason=0x7b
[1234.567893] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 1423 (python) total-vm:12345678kB
[1234.567900] UVM: failed to allocate 1289438720 bytes
```
ryan: I saw a spike in unified memory telemetry earlier today. Xid 79 can mean GPU timeout, but UVM allocation failures point to UM migration issues. Can we try disabling UVM to see if it's a pure UVM regression?
mike: will try a rerun with `NVIDIA_DISABLE_UVM=1`. repro command I'm using:
```
./infra/ci/run_nightly.sh --job 9213 --node h100-4 --capture dmesg,nvlog --env NVIDIA_DISABLE_UVM=1
```
ci-bot: rerun scheduled: gpu-nightly/9213 [rerun-2] by mike. Artifacts will be at https://ci.redwood/9213/rerun-2
anu: if rerun reproduces, please bisect by running the job against an older driver (534.x) image to check for a driver regression. tag me when you have results.
mike: rerun finished — still failing. quick nvml tail:
```
[ERROR] nvml: cuInit failed: unknown error
[WARN] UVM: failed to allocate 1200000000 bytes
[INFO] process 1423 killed by oom-killer
```
sophia: can you upload `dmesg | tail -n 200` and `/var/log/messages`? If the node kernel was bumped recently that would explain ABI mismatches.
mike: uploaded dmesg and syslog to artifacts link. node shows kernel 6.6.0-rc and the image driver package is the 535 build. dev note: we rolled node kernel ->6.6 last week.
ryan: 6.6 + 535 rings a bell — there are a couple upstream reports about UVM regressions on that combo. plan: pin CI image to driver 534.x and rerun smoke for 24h. I'll open a PR to change the infra image tag.
anu: agree, do the PR and mark hotfix for nightly. also create an incident ticket to track potential customer impact.
mike: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2418 pinned driver to 534.86 and added quick smoke job. kicked off smoke run. monitoring telemetry now. :thumbsup:
infra-oncall: noted. if smoke fails I'll escalate to hw team and page oncall. subscribing to the artifacts and alerts.
ryan: thanks team — if the pin fixes it we'll roll to the rest of CI and add a postmortem for the kernel-driver upgrade process.
